focus: Immutable editable-backup staging, explicit import choices, async dismissal/cancellation/error boundaries, preservation of unsaved scene and undo/redo, and stale result reuse under the existing m02-m03-code-v2 contract.
review_type: remote pinned-source and test-source review; no runtime execution

checks.evidence: LightingPlanExportMenu captures name, scene and text at button activation into let properties of a fresh UUID snapshot. sheet(item:) creates LightingPlanExportFlow with .id(snapshot.id); format choice is sheet-local and starts at formats. ProjectBackupView accepts value inputs and ProjectBackupFile retains immutable encoded Data. Neither preparation nor exporter completion writes Studio or its library.

prepare checks cancellation before scheduling and before publication, propagates task cancellation to the detached worker and keeps an existing prepared document alive during the system exporter. Failed preparation can retry with a new task id. Success text occurs only in exporter success completion; new export attempts clear prior message/error flags and NSUserCancelledError is ignored.

ProjectLibraryView blocks mutation/import while saved != scene and requires a single selected URL. After asynchronous read it rechecks dirty state, availability, capacity, active request UUID, cancellation and acceptingImports. Import is an explicit create command; no library or scene mutation is performed by ProjectDocumentIO.read.

Before commit, cancelImport rotates the request UUID and cancels the task; dismissal closes acceptingImports. read(from:) checks caller cancellation after detached completion so a cancelled read cannot publish a usable result. Once onApply reserves the mutation, isCommittingImport prevents cancellation from discarding the committed receipt. Studio owns and reconciles the commit independently of sheet dismissal.

Export receives scene/title values and no editing/history callbacks. applyLibrary rejects unsaved scene mutations. beginLibraryOperation reserves against the editor generation and adopts the returned result before changing scene/saved/library; history resets only when adoption.resetsHistory requests it. No backup-preview path reaches this mutation boundary.

checks.evidence: testFullLibraryCanPrepareUnsavedEditableCopyWithoutSavingOrChangingHistory creates an unsaved fourth light at full capacity, prepares a copy, dismisses, opens the PDF format, exercises Undo and Redo, reopens a fresh three-light snapshot, and relaunches to verify the unsaved light was never saved. testExportPreviewOpensWithoutSavingOrChangingScene cancels the chooser and checks unchanged unsaved status and disabled undo/redo, then prepares and dismisses the PDF.
